metPlannerCodeUpdateTmpExist.linkPhysicalTableInstance(metPlannerCodeUpdateTmp);
insert_recordset metPlannerCodeUpdateTmp (ItemId, CovInventDimId, PlannerCode, RuleSubSource, PlannerRecId) select ItemId from reqItemTable order by ItemId join metReqItemTable where metReqItemTable.RefRecId == reqItemTable.RecId join InventDimId from inventDim where inventDim.inventDimId == reqItemTable.CovInventDimId join inventTable where inventTable.ItemId == reqItemTable.ItemId join inventItemGroupItem where inventItemGroupItem.ItemId == inventTable.itemId && inventItemGroupItem.ItemDataAreaId == curExt() join ecoResProductCategory where ecoResProductCategory.Product == inventTable.Product join PlannerCode, RuleSubSource, RecId from metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules where metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleSubSource == metReqItemTable.SubSource && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleEnabled == NoYes::Yes

&& ((metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId && !_useBlankSiteWH) || (metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == '' && _useBlankSiteWH))

(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategory == ecoResProductCategory.Category && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategoryHierarchy == ecoResProductCategory.CategoryHierarchy && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorAccount == reqItemTable.VendId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleItemGroup == inventItemGroupItem.ItemGroupId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategory == ecoResProductCategory.Category && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleItemGroup == inventItemGroupItem.ItemGroupId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategoryHierarchy == ecoResProductCategory.CategoryHierarchy && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategory == ecoResProductCategory.Category && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategoryHierarchy == ecoResProductCategory.CategoryHierarchy && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleItemGroup == inventItemGroupItem.ItemGroupId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorAccount == reqItemTable.VendId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategory == ecoResProductCategory.Category && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorAccount == reqItemTable.VendId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId) ||
(metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleProductCategoryHierarchy == ecoResProductCategory.CategoryHierarchy && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorAccount == reqItemTable.VendId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorSite == inventDim.InventSiteId && metPlannerCodeAssignmentRules.RuleVendorWarehouse == inventDim.InventLocationId))
notexists join metPlannerCodeUpdateTmpExist where metPlannerCodeUpdateTmpExist.ItemId == reqItemTable.ItemId && metPlannerCodeUpdateTmpExist.CovInventDimId == reqItemTable.CovInventDimId;
}
